contexts.text: This is the mystical union... AC 1013:3.
A horse, in the mystical sense...
They call it a mystical thing of no use. AC 3482:end.
It appears as if (Solomon's Song) contains something mystical.

The Jews and some Christians believe that... there is something concealed in the Word which they call mystical... But they do not know what this mystical is. If told that this mystical sense in the Word... must be such as to be with the Angels... and that there can be no other mystical sense in the Word... and that this mystical sense... is nothing else than the spiritual and celestial sense... and that if they knew what good and truth are... they might know this mystical sense... scarcely anyone believes it.
I cannot do otherwise than open those things which are called the mystical things of the Word; that is, its interior things...
They call (what is internal or spiritual) mystical.
Those skilled in mystical scientifics were called magi; those skilled in non-mystical ones were called the wise. Explained.
Those who investigated these things... were called the wise; for they were mystical.
The mystical arcana... in the Word, lie hidden solely (in the correspondences).
Calls the interiors of the Word mystical, for which he cares not.
By the mystical union... are meant their figments...
In this mystical thing (concerning the three Divine Persons).
On account of the mystical and enigmatical faith which makes every point of the present theology.
The doctors... study the mystical things of the present faith...
Like the mystical things of the ancient poets.
The arcana of wisdom of the three Heavens which are in the Word are the mystical things of which many speak.
The mystical things which some search for in the Word are nothing else than its spiritual and celestial sense.
